text: Went back for lunch on a Friday.  Greeted at our table by Gabby who was upbeat and friendly.  She answered all questions and any requests were met with a resounding "no problem" attitude.   She's a keeper.   Started off with the cheesesteak egg rolls that I had last time.  Still one of the best I've had. The Siracha ketchup has the perfect kick to it without being too hot.   I got the Montreal burger which was a special and was outstanding and cooked perfect medium as requested.  One of the top burgers I've had.  My wife got the fish tacos and she said they ranked with the best she's had.  She doesn't like spice so asked Gabby for an alternative sauce and Gabby brought two different options that ended up working.  Can't wait to go back

Amazing smoothies!!! The interior is really nice and clean and inviting! The staff are all super friendly and will definitely help cater to any of your needs! Haven't gotten around to trying their food but it's the place i'll have in mind next time I'm hungry! Definitely recommend

Definitely my favorite brunch place in town. I love the location, the setting, the food, the service, and just the whole vibe. My favorite things to order are eggs en cocotte and sweet beignets. The brunch is very affordable but the dinner is definitely more pricer but equally delicious.

If I really wrote all of the things I love about the wine cellar, my post would be three pages long, so I'll keep it short and succinct. Fantastic atmosphere, great staff, amazing wine selection, delicious food, good location. Love this place.

I was pretty skeptical when my girlfriend insisted we try the sausage place in front of Home Depot, but (as always) I'm glad I listened. This location is less of a restaurant and more a corridor of meat. The flat-top stretches from end to end and divide the chef and the tireless cooks. On the flat top, coils and coils of Italian sausage is constantly being cooked just to meet the constant demand. The menu is simple and you can pretty much get whatever you want on the sausage. The consensus favorite from us is the Rocco Special which is a sausage topped with steak. It's hard to find something that loaded for just $7!
This is one of my favorite places to eat. Always good service and the food is excellent.  I highly recommend cracker barrel.
The Fish Tacos were incredible..However I was sitting on the southeast corner of the building and got bit by a spider...I love above our table and there are spider webs...get pest control...

I really enjoyed my experience with this restaurant. It's a small little place that I drive by a lot. After reading several good reviews about this place I decided to give it a try and I was not disappointed. I ordered a calzone and my wife ordered a hot sandwich. We were both very happy with our order. I will be adding this place to my normal restaurant list. I would recommend calling ahead and placing your order if you don't want to wait; everything is made to order. Staff was incredibly friendly as well. All and all, a great experience.

Excellent food, great variety, good prices and excellent service.
I always enjoy eating lunch here.

Wow . We were walking around trying to decide where to eat . We walked for miles and miles it seemed. We were famished . We decided to stop here because it was super hot and they had air conditioning. But OMG this place went above and beyond . I live in Colorado and the Mexican there is sub par at best so it's hard for me to take Mexican food risks but this was 100% amazing . The queso original and with the crawfish. Superb !!! My husband had the salmon and I was like we are at a Mexican restaurant you're supposed to eat Mexican but he was not disappointed. The seasoning in the salmon was something he had never had before and it was flavorful . Top notch oh I forgot the margaritas- pineapple / cilantro - two things to me that doesn't sound like they go well together but add tequila and bam  amazing . Could this get any better oh yes they have a strawberry  vanilla margarita a perfect ending to a fabulous meal .

My husband and I came here on a Saturday night after getting a craving for ramen. We arrived around 7:30 (the place closes at 9) and it was packed! Most of the tables were full plus many people were waiting for carry out orders.

You order at the counter before you sit and they give you a number to take back to your table.  There's a menu on the wall and a more detailed description at the counter. While the drink selections are limited and relatively expensive ($2-3 for a can of non alcoholic beverage), the food portions are relatively large. We were so happy to see a favorite of ours as well, royal milk tea. By the time we finished ordering, more spots had opened up. 

We  both ordered spicy miso and one order of pork gyoza. The food came out pretty quickly and the miso immediately smelled amazing. The gyoza was good, but a bit oily and not super warm - regardless, I would get it again. This time may have been a fluke. The miso was hot and spicy! The flavors were fantastic in the broth and there were plenty of toppings. We each ate our bowls quickly dreaming of the next time we can visit.
We have been several times, very pleased. The Sangria is delicious as are the meatballs.

Love this place.  I live close to the passyunk location, and happened to be working on south st today, so glad i found this spot.  Got the lox special and a hot chai, was awesome.  Best bagels in the city by far.  Always fresh, like their passyunk location, no oven on site, so I got my bagel toasted and it was delish.  Thank you for having the best bagels in the city!
Gotta get some more of those stuffed crabs. I've been thinking about them all week  love me some peewees

Always love coming to this place for brunch! Their seating is really cute especially if you get their booths! Located in downtown St. Louis, parking can at times be challenging but paid parking is always an option.  My favourite sandwich of theirs is the 'sunshine unlimited' but no matter what I will always get a popover with their sweet spreads! So delicious!
Amazing Thai food ! I ordered the red curry with shrimp. It was delicious. You can taste the freshness. Made to order. Nice aroma and a hint of coconut. Need to go back and try other dishes.

Their coffee tastes good and their is a good selection of food and treats. 

The one downside is that the prices seem pretty high.

Low staffed, sat down took 25 minutes to get a menu, 45 minutes to have our order taken. Sushi was not good. Yellow tail tasted like it had gone bad. 2 stars because of the wait time, lack of care by the staff (hostess was sitting around uninterested) and the terrible sushi. The sushi chefs looked dull, bored and like they could care less about their product. Gyoza was good. I ate the gyoza and one yellow tail roll and refused to eat anything else. Won't return.

Group of 10 on a Wednesday evening, not busy. Everyone's arrived by 6:15 and we were entering drink/appetizers. Starts out fine, but we order 2 of the same appetizers for the whole table. 45 minutes to come out. 20 mins after app orders are entered we order dinner. Literally an actual hour to bring out our food, it was insane. The waitress was very nice but it was actually painful how long it took her to come back and do things. Finally after we're done eating we ask the waitress to bring out the cake we brought. 10-15 mins pass, no one clears the table so we start stacking dishes ourselves to make room, she finally comes back and we again ask for the cake. Another 10 minutes and the cake finally comes out. It's now 8:30 at this point. 




Not a lot of food was ordered at all. I realize 10 guests can be a lot but the wait time became absolutely ridiculous that we think she was taking orders then actually waiting 15 minutes before entering or doing anything. Awful experience, there was no reason we needed to spend 2+ hours at this restaurant. It was not by choice at all and they seemed to be completely unaware how terrible the wait time was because no one apologized to us once.

Disappointed!!! Long wait and as a seafood lover of Lobster can say they are overpriced roughly $30 tail and over cooked. You will receive enough salt and vegetables with your order to feed multiple people. Can't say this is the choice for seafood in Music City. Far from a seafood restaurant. They more or less serve seafood as a side with Vegetables as the main dish.

This was my first time st Hattie B's. Line was out the door and we had to wait in line for a bit to order but apparently it's expected.  

My husband and I got the half chicken- medium hot. It has nice kick but I wish I tried the hot. Chicken was good but I expected it to be juicier and more flavorful.  The greens were not very flavorful and I was disappointed. 

Overall,  it was a fun experience and I'm glad I tried it. If you don't want to wait in line,  order it through the to go window.  There was no line there.

We came here for restaurant week and the food was amazing!!! The service was really good too. 

We started with a bottle of wine from their extensive list. Restaurant week has a prefix menu and you got to choose 3 items. We all tried to get something different and share. 

I started with the Lobster bisque and it was to die for. Creamy yet so much flavor. My husband got the Kung pao calami as his appetizer. It has a nice kick to it and it was a fun spin on a classic calamari dish. 
For my entree I got the Amish chicken and my husband got a steak. I loved mine. The sherry cream sauce with prosciutto was the perfect savory and salty combo. He barely shared the steak with me because it was so perfectly cooked which meant it was delicious. For the final course we got the chocolate terrine and orange cheesecake. I am an absolute chocolate lover but this cheesecake blew my socks off. It had the subtle hints of zesty orange sweetness with the cheesecake filling. Yum! 

Everything was absolutely phenomenal from the service, drinks and food. I love all the CRG restaurants but this one might be at the top of my list!

Ordered a make your own combo with the snow crab  new Zealand mussels and head on shrimp. All of the food had been previously frozen so the texture was inconsistent. The head on shrimp were split like they were cleaned but about 60% were not cleaned properly. The mussels were also improperly cleaned 2-3 were inedible. My crab legs were ok the boom sauce I had was oily not buttery. I think the biggest problem with this place is cheap product sold at a premium price, lack of standards and a poor copy of a proven restaurant concept. First and last visit

I have ordered twice and every time I call the male who answers the phone is extremely rude. In once occasion I called in at 11:30 am and they told me it would be ready in 40 minutes. I got there at 12:15 and they said it would be ready in 10 minutes. It was 12:40 and my pizza was still not ready. I think the my pizza was just being made when I got there. Another time I called in and again the male rushed me while with my order. I will no longer order pizzas from Mamas. Very disappointed in the take out order

This is one of the best places to go to and have Americanized Greek food! The service is exceptional and there are two girls that are always greeting us at the door. They are so sweet and are very hardworking and are able to finish our order in a timely manner. Their gyro pitas are so fulfilling and there is not one thing I've tried that I didn't like. I recommend everyone to go and visit this place. Thank you girls for all the samples too!!

Everything including the food, service, variety of games and ambience at this establishment is top notch. 

Our instructor, Connor, was the best too! 

Our group had a fun time learning from him. He was incredibly patient with my unteachable boyfriend who finally ended up a pro by the time our session came to a close! Thank God!

We stopped in Carpinteria on our way to Aptos, CA.  Carpinteria is a very quiet beach town in May.  Located south of Santa Barbara beach crowds should be filling this place up when summer starts.  Maggie found Oaxaca Fresh next door to the ice cream shop I was looking for.  Place looked like a nice family run restaurant.  

Chips were warm and crunchy with a light salt flavor.  Pretty good.

I ordered a taco plate with rice and beans.  I don't normally get beans but these beans had a mild flavor that I liked.  Rice was soft and moist with a light tomato flavor.  Carne asada taco came with a flour tortilla with a mild flavor.  Carne asada was tender with a delicious sweet and savory flavor.  Carnitas taco had great tasting fried pork that wasn't dry.

2nd visit.
Halibut fish taco was tender, juicy, and had a nice flavor.

Al pastor taco was well spiced and had a bit of heat.

The two taco plate made for a good lunch but wasn't filling enough for dinner.  My favorite was the carne asada with the carnitas a close second.  Oaxaca Fresh Mexican Grill was a nice relaxing restaurant to visit in the off season.

This is our new fave sushi spot! We got a belated anniversary date night and had been given a gift certificate from some friends, so AYCE was a go! Oh, lucky us...it was also freebie sake night Thursday! Bonus!
The wait was short, and tho we had to wait outside in the cold, we were given an order ticket and went to work!  We ticked the apps, rolls and nigiri we wanted to try, and wow! those plates came flying almost as soon as we got to our table! 
The sushi selections were numerous, and we enjoyed each roll we tried. The octopus & yellowtail nigiri - our typical "litmus test" for fish freshness - were both very tasty and fresh! 
We got another order form for a few more items and they refilled our sake, and we were both stuffed full and tipsy in no time at all. I suppose it may be a tad bit rushed, but it kept the tables turning over and wait time short. It didn't bother us enough to not come back, and have already recommended Tokyo to friends and would like to return!

On March 30 I called in a takeout order for TN Whiskey Cake; was told 5-10 mins.  Due to traffic didn't get there until 20 mins later.  No greeter at door, so went to the bar; bartender directed me to the kitchen.  Four employees talking at the kitchen door; didn't acknowledge me but scattered when I approached.  Lots of employees coming and going (this is a very poor place to have customers wait!).  A few minutes later, someone asked if I needed help.  He checked on my order and said they were working on an 80-person baseball team order.  Two other customers arrived for take out orders.  Kitchen door was now almost completely blocked.  25 mins later (now 45 mins after my call), still no cake.  I went to the front door to ask for a business card so I could  contact the manager.  Was told no cards were available.  Asked to see the manager; sorry - he's busy on the phone.  Having wasted almost an hour for one piece of cake, I left and visited another restaurant.  Absolutely terrible service!
I have been here three times since they opened. We have never waited for longer than 15 minutes. The salad I ordered was the best salad I've ever had. Sweet honey pecan salad. So good.
The service gets 5 stars.  Breakfast was average..not bad, just nothing to write home about.

A tasty, tiny 
Cheesesteak. Sweeter onion taste. 
Good single serving


*they are open and we did take out- super fast

Food was great!! Awesome atmosphere and reasonable prices!! I tried the bacon burger and fries my husband had the fish and chips we both enjoyed our choices plus our bill was great!! We will surely come back and try other choices
Honestly cannot understand why the reviews are so bad here. Yes, the staff is extremely rude. Beyond rude. But the food is amazing! Best Chinese ever! Take it to go :)

It's been quite some time that I've had the pleasure of eating here, but this place is so memorable and delicious that I'm going to give it an absentee 5-star rating. Never have I had better meats and cheeses in my 29 years of life. Their selection is incredible and the presentation is bar-none. 
I find myself daydreaming about St James at least weekly. I lived in New Orleans for 6 years and whenever someone asks me for recommendations for eating in the crescent city, I ALWAYS recommend st james. 

I hope to see you soon, old friend.

Rosy's you have become quite the staple in my foodie life.  From $1 tacos on Tuesdays, in general an awesome HH M-F, and the weekend brunch which is the best value in the city ($30 - entree plus 3 drinks); I am not sure why you don't have lines around the corner. 

My favorite options from the menu:
- Brunch: breakfast tacos
- HH - nachos
- Dinner - chorizo tacos and plantains 

Looking forward to tackling the remainder of the menu and making it to one of your trivia nights!

I would give 3.5 here if i could, but I would come back next time in town to try again. Beer selection is pretty weak and, honestly, so is the wine selection. Bread is pretty not special, calamari was over cooked and pretty tasteless. 

All that said, the swordfish special was AMAZING. Also, our service was great.

One note, they won't split checks, but it is noted on the menu so they don't hide it.

Disappointed with the quality of the food, but the service was true to name- very quick. We ordered two meals- chicken pad Thai and garlic and pepper chicken. The chicken for both meals was very dry and did not taste fresh. Both meals only had a few small pieces of chicken fragments, definitely not to standard . Also ordered crab Rangoon and the dumplings had very little inside. There were 7 pieces and all lacked any stuffing. I recommend going to any of the 3 other Thai restaurants minutes from this place.

My Japanese teacher recommend this place for me. One of the best Japanese fine dining in the town. All the food I ordered tasted awesome and worth it's not-low prices. If you want to try some Japanese food in town, here definitely is the place. The parking maybe a little hard along the nearby street.

Horrible...the lamb beef meat I had was overcooked shredded dry and flavorless....the pita was good.  However, for $11 sandwich  .... thumbs down...and the topper automatic gratuity of 10% ... really....this was counter service...

I usually don't like to eat ramen but when I do, I go to Terakawa. Out of all the places in Philly (strictly talking about the Philly area), I think this place does it the best. There's always a long line but the staff is extremely efficient. I really like that I can customize my ramen. I always order the Terakawa ramen with wavy egg noodles and request for the broth to be less salty, and noodles cooked firm. My only complaint is that the pork is not consistent; sometimes the pork is perfectly cooked and other times it's too dry and tough. I also really like their takoyaki and karage chicken curry (you can add a small bowl to your ramen order for just an additional $3).

So delicious ! The fries are the best and the Mac and cheese: this time I went for the fried chicken sandwich! Wash it all down the with them bourbon punch and you have a great day drinking day! The bourbon punch pitcher is so affordable you can't turn yourself away.
Absolutely FABULOUS meal...from the moment we walked in...the ambiance, the wine, the music, the service...and the food...AMAZING!!  One of her best meals I've had in the Boise area!!

You have to get the duck duck goose! My boyfriend and I don't even eat duck but today we did! I also enjoyed the calamari too! Good frozen margarita! We went on a Tuesday night around 8 and had to wait for an hour but the service was excellent!!!

My partner and I just LOVE coming here! The service is great, gorgeous restaurant, and the food is unlike anywhere else. My partner likes to start with the pork belly, and I won't come in without getting the french onion soup. Best I've had!! We both had steaks for dinner and decided to share a couple sides. My filet was cooked perfectly and my partner enjoyed his rib eye as well. I got the chimichurri sauce and he the red wine sauce, both are very good! We shared the asparagus, mushrooms, and potato puree and all were hot, perfectly seasoned and absolutely delicious! But the best part about the whole meal? Dessert! Charlie Palmer has some of the best desserts in town! When eating at Charlies, you eat til you're stuffed full and get dessert anyways because you can't pass on these. We couldn't decide between the butter cake or the chocolate cheesecake, so we got both! While the butter cake was amazing with lemon and raspberry compliments, the cheesecake was the star. Mango pieces on top with crispy coconut on the creamy, chocolatey cheesecake is what will keep us coming back! Can't wait to see they have to offer next time we decide to spend some money! It is pricey here, but between the great service and the incredible food, it's worth it! Thank you to our waiter Albert for taking such good care of us!

My family and I were trying to find a pizza joint to eat at but they were all so packed it was ridiculous... I got on google maps and found this place. The pizza was amazing !!! My 9 year old son is the pickiest of eaters and he devoured the bbq wings! We will be back the next time we want pizza! Thank you for making a great family dinner for us!!!

I always get the Los Agaves (fish) burrito. Whatever the sauce they smother the burrito with is simply amazing. I recommend getting the house salad with it, which is dressed with a sweet mango dressing.
They give you four types of salsa (and chips), but the chipotle one is the best by far. 

Also, important: Order through their website. Grubhub charges restaurants a ridiculous fee for their services.
The food wasn't very good. Menu wasn't appetizing. Ambiance was definitely there but at the end of the day I was unsatisfied with our meals. Mediocre at best.

What a DISASTER!  Thirty minute wait for two small orders or wings and one order of tater tots.  When the food final arrives the server,  McKenzey brings the bill as well and say that she needs me cash out right away so she can go on break. So, I pay the bill and watch McKenzie stand just 10 feet away from me at the hostess station and talk to her co-workers the entire time my daughter is eating. When stops by with to go drinks when we are finished. I mean, REALLY! Why not just tell me to get the hell out??

I think the servings are just so small for the prices that it simply is not good value for money. My burger was cold and not that great. I was so hungry I had to get a shroom burger but it was also very sparse and small. The fries looked good but I was trying to avoid fried food . I always leave feeling ripped off.
This place is lovely, with a friendly staff, retro atmosphere, and an extremely classy drink menu. Also, this fancy boy will greet you by the fireplace.
The doughnuts here are amazingly delicious! I will keep coming back for these wonderful bites of deliciousness! Cinnamon caramel is one of the best!

Enjoyed my first visit to Thai Table. I'm doing a Keto-ish eating plan and the online menu looked somewhat accommodating so we met my daughter and future son-law there for dinner. At first I ordered the Green Curry entree(Ghang Kiev Wan) and I asked the waitress if there was any added sugar and she said no. But after taking our order, she returned with a small sampling of the sauce and said the cook told her there was a small amount of sugar and he wanted me to try it to make sure it wasn't too sweet. I thought that was great service. 

I opted for the atom Kha Kai (coconut milk soup) and the Tom Yum Kung (hot and sour shrimp soup) - level 3 on spiciness. And they were outstanding. Very spicy. No sugar. 

My husband and daughter order pad Thai (my daughter has a gluten allergy so this was perfect for her). And they loved their food. My 11-year-old wanted plain chicken fried rice. Her order is the only reason I'm not giving the restaurant a 5 star review. They said they could do a smaller portion because they have no kids menu -  but the smaller portion is only $1 less and it's way too big for a kid. Plus when they say plain- it didn't even seem like it was much more than chicken and white rice. Very bland.

Did a search for great pizza.  This one came up
And did not disappoint!  Great service, fantastic pizza and made with NY water!  Yay!  
Not much for looks but great pizza!  Thanks guys

This is one of the worst restaurants I've ever been too. There is a male manager at this location while your ordering your food he rudely rushes you, and the order ends up wrong.  I managed Mcdonalds so I know how to order so I'm not one of those ppl who sit and act like I have no idea. Then when I have to be at work early in the morning the location says they open at 5:00am, it was 5:25am and they are never open on time. When you go by the window you see 4-5 workers none of them wearing a headset.
The service is so bad I was never able to try their food. They run their business as a hobby.

Sosososo good and fresh!! Only my second time but definitely returning for more! Service was great , very friendly ! Got the shroom and spinach both were great !! Loved both definitely want to go back to try the other selections !

My fiancé and I live close to Bull Market and we frequent here during the week for a quick, healthy dinner. The portions are a good size, and usually end up lasting me two meals. The food is always great. We usually can't stray past our typical order (a Bull Bowl for me, and a BYOB for him) because it's always so good!

Always a good meal at KC Prime. Good atmosphere too. 
This is a go to for a special occasion or date night.
Great food. Been craving it since I've been there. Wish the portions were bigger though.

I had been wanting to try brunch at The Local for some time now.  The parking lot is always packed and I had heard good things about it.  So you can imagine my disappointment when neither the food nor the service lived up to the hype.

My friend and I got there around 10:30 am. Since it had just opened, there weren't many people yet and we were seated immediately. I ordered the Hot Breakfast Bowl but ended up waiting over an hour for it. Approximately 40 minutes into our wait, our waitress came back and told us that the food would be right out. But nearly 30 minutes later, we were still waiting on our food. When she finally brought it out, our waitress apologized and told us there were issues with the grill and they were short-staffed. And while I completely understand that things like this happen, it would have been better to know up front about the issues and that the food would take so long because then I would have left and come back another time. 

Unfortunately, even after waiting an hour for my food, when it finally came out, it was cold and there was no flavor. The description from the menu said the Hot Breakfast Bowl was "cheesy grits and home fries smothered in sausage gravy with two eggs your way. Served with a fresh buttermilk biscuit." I ordered my eggs over medium and instead was served eggs over hard. The "fresh buttermilk biscuit" was anything but fresh. It was just short of a hockey puck biscuit.

I was really hoping for this to be my new brunch spot, but loo

This place was surprising. The roast beef sandwich and meatloaf sandwich are fantastic. The drinks were a little underwhelming but were solid. The service was great and the environment was awesome. Will come back for sure.

It was so delicious. I got the original eggs Benedict. My kids loved the Minnie Mouse pancakes. My coffee was always full. They gave me whip cream for my coffee since they don't have heavy whipping cream. Our serve was super friendly. We can't wait to go back

This was our first visit to North Italia, a mixed experience. From reading other reviews, it seems the food, service, and overall experience are not highly consistent - although the overall Yelp ratings are very favorable. We were seated after only a short wait, as promised, so got off to a good start on a fairly busy mid-week night. We weren't given complimentary bread & butter (or oil) but some other reviews indicated they had; we decided not to pay $4 for plain bread. My husband asked 3 times for a lemon slice for his water before he got it and I waited a long while for my glass of wine (he got his beer more promptly). Our food was tasty but not the best we've ever had and moderate portions for the price (squid ink pasta & bolognese). Our server was friendly and stopped by fairly often after an initial delay, but didn't tell us about any specials (we overheard another waiter at the next table pointing out featured items). Looks like there are some definite winners on the menu, based on other reviews, so IF I went back I would try those but am more likely to go elsewhere given other options for Italian food in Tucson.

Best (and largest) gyro in town. The gyro meat tastes fresh and delicious, the tzatziki plentiful, plus lots of tomatoes and onions. If you're not a big eater, consider splitting the gyro with your dinner partner.

The atmosphere lacks charisma but service is quick. Next time I return to Tarpon Springs I will taste other menu items.

So yummy!!! We love a good wood fired pizza! Very reasonably priced for being in the fashion mall. Cool atmosphere for sure. We loved the outdoor seating and our dog got to join us too! Will totally be back!

Had ppl just standing there. The burgers were just covered in sauce and the patty was drie and u could tell that they don't change the oil for the fryer cuz my fries came out dark and covered with black stuff from the previous food that was fried there

This place is one of the busiest bars on the greenbelt.  It is nice to listen to live music and enjoy the river but it takes a long time to get served.  The last time we were there there were open seats and we still had to wait about 10 minutes to get seated (at the seats that we could plainly see were open!)After being seated two other couples who didn't have to wait to get seats got to order before us... I just wish they could find consistency in how they operate.  Mixed drinks definitely not worth the price here.  Fool me once shame on you, fool me twice shame on me.

Tony made us a margherita even though it isnt on the menu and this was easily the best margherita me and my coworker have ever had. We've tried almost every pizza place within 10 miles from our work and this takes the #1 spot without a doubt.
Seafood is really good. I'm from Louisiana and it's hard to find seafood the way I'm used to having it seasoned but the catfish and shrimp has amount of spice on it.

I have been here about 5 times now and I have never had a bad experience. The food is always good and the service is quick and the price is around the same as the other Thai places in this area. Walking in, it is a dimly lit - more intimate setting with an awesome bar wall (about 10 feet of wine bottles from bar height up) - this place is decorated well and creates a good ambiance. The food has always been great, I haven't strayed too far from my norm (Pad Thai and Orange Chicken) because I know that I will get a great meal and be satisfied afterward! 

Yesterday we decided to get an appetizer and we settled on the Chicken Satay - this was a great decision, however, it was most definitely an appetizer for only two and no more (small serving size). The Chicken Satay is thinly sliced chicken on skewers and then grilled - it also comes with a sweet cucumber salad (amazing!) and peanut sauce. The peanut sauce was good, but I wish it were a bit hotter (spice) and a bit thicker - but I love that it was soft chunks of peanuts in it. I got the Orange Chicken and got it as spicy as it could be and it was AMAZING - I have never gotten it that spicy but it added the right amount of kick that I was looking for and satisfied my craving! Jordan got the Thai Basil Chicken Fried Rice (his go-to for any Thai place) and he was said it was great and the medium spice level was perfect for him! I tried some of his and I liked it too - oftentimes I think the basil can overpower the rest of the fla

Absolutely terrible experience. I won't speak of the food itself, that was disappointing enough. My real issue is with the service we received from the manager Morund or Morun, not sure of the spelling. Our food was dry and subpar but we didn't complain being that we are restaurant guys from a high end steakhouse ourselves. Towards the end of our meal we ordered a ginger ale and seconds after it arrived to our table we noticed a roach stuck to an ice cube and another on the inner rim of the glass. After notifying the server, we watched her make Morund aware of the situation and he seemed completely un-rattled by issue. After about 5 minutes the server drops off a new beverage and the manager follows behind her and grabs our plates and walks away. Clearly we were not going to consume the remainder of our food or another beverage, no telling what else had roaches in it. The manager showed a complete lack of care, compassion or simply gave an F. He just said nothing and walked away. At this point I didn't say anything either, I was completely dumbfounded that he wouldn't even address the problem. On top of that, not a single item was removed from our bill nor even an apology. Definitely a terrible representation of your brand or maybe it's an accurate one. Who knows.

Ca'Dario has a great ambience outside during COVID-19 and the best Italian food ever. If you want the best service and Italian food,this is your place. They have new spot,super cool in Montecito. I love it . Everything is so clean,safe and delicious.  Super high recommend. Enjoy Ca'Dario and cheers .

Absolutely fabulous take out meal special for 4.  Everything was delicious. Steak was cooked to perfection. The best take out meal we've had during the Covid 19 lock out.  Highly recommend!  Will order again soon.

This is definately something you did not expect from St. Louis.... The food was phenomenal! The issan hamachi is a must try. Most places Is American/Asian fusion but this place really knocked it out of the park with the Thai/Jap fusion concept. Restaurant is small, around the block from the botanical gardens with its own parking lot.
I do think they should expand the menu as they only have a good 12 items on the menu. They also have a small list of nigiri that was fresh but nothing special ($12 for 2pcs). Overall this place is the latest and greatest if you want to try sitting different.

If you're going to hold a private event that takes up the ENTIRE restaurant, notify patrons with more than a paper sign outside so we don't drive 40 minutes to get here. My 38 week pregnant self does not appreciate this drive and lack of communication.

This restaurant was a very mediocre experience for me. One of the waitresses seemed to have an attitude with a couple of elder customers and even with her coworkers. The vibes were a little off from the beginning. Also, there was no one sitting inside besides one other couple and it felt very awkward and quiet. On the plus side, the wine is delicious and extremely affordable! They had plenty of options and the server was able to guide us in the right direction. If you go here I would suggest sitting outside because the ambiance is a lot more enjoyable.

I had never tried this place, did a few GrubHub deliveries from here when I worked GH. 

Have been here 3 times now. Its inexpensive and very yummy Chinese food. 

I want to thank them for today. I ordered my usual white rice, teriyaki chicken and coconut chicken. I get out the door and down the steps and stumbled, then dropped the bag. The styrofoam container popped open, as they are apt to do when dropped feet. I was so dissatisfied. I went back in and explained what happened. They replaced my food! No longer disappointed.

The other night me and my daughter order two pieces of plain cheesecake and to my disappointment the cheesecake was grainy it wasn't that sweet I don't know it was just it was awful and that was my first time ordering from the cheesecake factory but I never will again host I got to get a restraining imma give it a one
Awesome customer service from Cory. You made our visit in New Orleans memorable. And of course the food's great!!!! The pizza that we had was excellent.

Great food, at a great priced, served by the kindest people. I placed a large pick-up order and then arrived early... they offered me a bowl of fresh chips and salsa while I waited. Everyone working was so sweet and gracious. They added two free Mexican sodas to our order just because. Everyone in the group tried different tacos (carnitas, chorizo, adobo chicken, chicken Tinga, and cochinita) and all were amazing. We also got the massaman nachos, fried plantains, and chips and guacamole. The serving of guacamole is massive! They were out of al pastor when we ordered, so we'll definitely be going back for that!

This place is sooo good!! My family has lived a few blocks away for years and I don't know why we never tried it. First of all, the food is delicious-- fried rice, shumai, duck are some of the things we've tried so far and it's all literally perfect for the kind of chinese take out Im looking for. Second, everyone that works there on the phone and when I've gone to pick up the food is so nice and efficient. Definitely try this place!

I've been eating at this place for a long time. It was sad to see them shut down for silver months because of the pandemic. Great to see them open and still doing business. Great people. Best Asian food around as far as I'm concerned. Love their Hot Pepper chicken as well as the Kung Pao chicken and egg drop soup.

My husband is a donut lover and is crazy about this place! Their creative donuts and classic flavorful apple crisps are always approved. I've only got one item of critique: The daily selection is very different from the actual menu. They run out of things easily so don't set your heart on a certain treat. Otherwise, the drive thru is invaluable!

All I have to say is slow cooked brisket tacos and burritos. Need I say more?
Food was amazing, window service for orders and pickup it it was cooked great. This is a pretty small place but has great ambiance good prices and some unique and great tastes. Just off the beaten path for a nice getaway

The Last Hotel is a dream! It's so fresh and swanky! This is our go to hotel when we want to take a little staycation! The staff is beyond accommodating and kind! They go the extra mile every single time we visit! The prices are great & currently all rooms come with a $20 food and drink credit! They have 2 bar areas one in the lobby and another rooftop next to the pool. They enclose it in winter months so it's always comfortable. We will certainly be back!

Went with a group of coworkers and really enjoyed the food, drink and atmosphere, great service too!  There are pages and pages of drinks for every taste. I enjoyed trying two of the KY Bourbons recommended by the beverage lead (Willet Family Pot Still and Noah's Mill) and others in the party had scotch or beer.    For food, we had brisket (outstanding) , smoked turkey leg (outstanding but ask them to skip the sauce or put it on the side because I thought it distracted), St. Louis ribs (not my favorite style but others in the party liked them), and smoked turkey breast.    Several different sauces depending on your personal preference.  Sides included some of the best collards I have ever tried, pit beans (outstanding) , mac & cheese, coleslaw, and pickles. All good.   Casual atmosphere and friendly competent attentive wait staff.

Love this place! The staff is really friendly! The owner is awesome! Great atmosphere! It's just fun here! If you're looking for a casual, upbeat place with great smashburgers, you've gotta swing by and grab some lunch on their patio!

On July 19th, in the midst of the COVID second wave and a mandatory county mask mandate, I picked up a pizza for dinner and absolutely appalled! 

Four employees, including the manager, were not wearing masks properly. The manager and 2 other had nose out.  The manager was divvying up cash with a driver, and handling money. And the kid handing me my order had the mask over his chin exposing the whole mouth! I see a kid because I could clearly see the peach fuzz mustache he was trying to grow. 

I'm very disappointed. It makes me question if they're washing their hands frequently enough, or keeping the place clean. Have some respect for your patrons and follow the basic safety regulations.

Sincerely, lost customer.

Top notch.  During this crazy pandemic, they serve not only great food at reasonable prices, they serve the community. Great specials, ample portions and the most consistent restaurant in Santa Barbara.  Try them.

Pretty good seafood!! I ordered the steamed mussel appetizer which came in a butter herb broth. I usually prefer tomato but the one it came with was quite nice as well. My friend got the fish and chips and really enjoyed it. The fish and chips also came with coleslaw which I am usually a huge fan of, but this one was quite bland.

This was our first time visiting this area. While visiting FL our cousin suggested we stop by. The view was beautiful and the weather was perfect. Unfortunately when we arrived, there weren't any more seats outside. The inside looks like your typical sports bar and the bartender/waiter was really nice and accommodating. 
The food unfortunately could have been better. We ordered the potato skins and crab cakes.

Top 3 meals I've ever had in my 40+ years.  Took a friend from out of town and we sat at the chef's counter.  It was a fun place to watch food preparations and the making of the best pita I've tasted in my life.  We ordered fantastic cocktails and the sampling menu that came with a variety of appetizers from the menu and we each got to choose an entree.  I had grilled, delicious, perfect, flavorful swordfish and my friend had the slow roasted lamb.  Each and every bite of every single thing exceeded my expectations.  It was all absolutely divine and delicious.  It's not often that I walk away from a restaurant with that quality of food.  I would go back every single week if I could.  Unbelievable.  Also, the woman who was our server was wonderful and very helpful with suggestions on what to order.  She was spot on.  Suraya is not to miss!
Food was good, but not great. This is better option than most other airport food locations.

Last week I took a trip to Bella Italia looking to grab a quick slice. I am a  Jersey/New Yorker pizza type of guy, so it was time to try out some Philly slices. To be honest, the pizza was very good with key attributes of: thin, large, good crust, non greasy and a great cheese to sauce ratio. 

I also had the chicken parm sandwich but, it wasn't necessarily anything worth note taking. 

If you are in the area hungry and looking for a quick slice, I'd  recommend this place for you.

Not one to write reviews but this was the worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant. Service and food were terrible. We were sat quickly on the rooftop tonight which was nice. We were sat a table with no salt and pepper or silverware just menus.. okay.. so my boyfriend and I start browsing the menu and pick drinks and our food since no one came up to us for 10 minutes. Our waiter comes by with water and drops a drink menu then runs away. Awesome. Wait another 10 minutes and he finally comes back. My boyfriend orders a beer they didn't have which was fine so he got something different. I ordered a lemonade and they were out of it so I ordered a root beer instead and what do you know they're out of that too. No big deal I just got a coke. We order our food and wait for our drinks. 5 minutes goes by, no drinks but our appetizer of calamari came out quickly and the food runner just drops it. Mind you we still have no plates or silverware but we eat it anyway. Calamari was super plain the menu said it came with stuff on it and it literally came with nothing but marinara. Then our food comes out. I got a ny strip steak and my boyfriend got a pineapple chicken sandwich. When I say Applebee's could of made better food I'm not kidding. I had to go up to the server who was completely non existent this whole time and ask for salt and pepper after the hostess finally brought silverware. Not once did he ask if we needed anything or how anything was. If we wanted another drink. Nothin

Had a late lunch here with a friend. I ordered a simple Pretzel breakfast sandwich (which didn't come with anything) and a side of home fries.  The flavors of everything? Dull. The pretzel was the only thing that truly had flavor in my sandwich.  It was luke warm and kinda on the dry side.  The home fries were absolutely pitiful. They were soggy, lacked flavor, and looked like they were leftover from the previous day. The restaurant was clean and bright, but seem cramped with space. I attempted to use the restroom that was right next to an entrance to the kitchen and twice I was almost ran over by staff and once staff ignored me as I tried to pass by. Service was about average. Nothing special. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.
My partner and I went here for a last minutes valentine's dinner and it was phenomenal!! the food was amazing and our server, Danny, was so kind and wonderful! I would absolutely come back here.
Excellent pizza! We went twice on vacation. Not much seating. We had a issue with our order and they were very polite and fixed it right away.

Let me start by saying that the food here is amazing.

Unfortunately our visit was not. We made a reservation for the Saturday night before valentine's Day. We were called twice throughout the week to verify our reservation which also required a credit card to be made on open table. We confirmed and arrived about two minutes after eight. Our hostess sat us right away. And we had a nice table near the bar.

We were greeted about five minutes later and then we're not able to place a drink order for about 10 after that. We placed a drink and cheese board order around 815 820. The drinks did not come out until around 8:30. At 8:45 the table next to us that was sent at 8:30 received their cheeseboard and drinks. But we had yet to receive anything. I mentioned it to our waiter who was the same at both tables and she looked at us and said "oh I forgot". It was 847 and all we had had were drinks. She made no attempt to recover. She brought the cheeseboard out and then asked if we wanted to order another round of $15 drinks. She then spent the entire night trying to get us to order another round of drinks. We finally were done with our 8 o'clock reservation at 9:45. 


While the food was good I don't see myself returning because of the lack of diligence and attention that we were paid on what was supposed to be a special night. 

And it was extra frustrating because no other table around us was facing this type of terrible service.

The best Shrimp Pho ever.
Mixed with bok choy, portobello and enoki mushrooms.
AMAZING. 
The Brisket Banh Mi is amazing as well.

I've dined at the Buddakan in New York a few times and it's truly one of my top 5 restaurants. I felt compelled to leave another review for the Buddakan in Philadelphia because it was just that good. The food was somewhat "tastier" than the NY location. The serve was also great. I started off with the general tso dumplings of course and they were to die for. I had the snapper and it melted in mouth. 
This location is smaller than the NY location but it packed a punch. The food was exceptionally good here. 

Will return the next time i am in Philly

The best mimosas and breakfast everrrr, mostly they're busy but if you're lucky you can get in and enjoy the super delicious breakfast, each dish is piece of art, you can taste the heaven in each bite and sip .

Service 10/10 
Atmosphere 10/10
Food 11/10 

I've dined here several times, had different dishes at the table each time and all of them have been incredible. The price point is fair for what you receive and you pay a touch more for the love they put into their food. It's so worth it. The servers are all very accommodating and friendly. It's laid back, but still a fine tuned experience. I never write reviews, but this place deserves 5 stars. 

PS: Get the mussels, lasagna(chicken or beef and delicious), and the specials are spot on too.

This is a magical little restaurant. Best cocktails in Nashville - French 75 and the Old Fashion are superior. 
The ambience is great. Makes you feel like you are in Europe...especially when the Ginko trees are in fully bloomed and you are sitting out on the patio. 
The menu is diverse. The grape leaves and lamb cassoulet are dependable and excellent. The filet is excellent paired with some of their wines from Lebanon (the country....not the city in Tennessee). 
The dessert, kenafah, is probably one of the most interesting and delicious desserts I've had in my life. Don't let the "cheese" fool you. It's a perfect end to any meal here with a cafe americano. 
Parking is easy. Local owner who cares about his staff and his clientele is definitely evident when you walk in. 
Enjoy.

We had great food last night, and this morning. I had the catfish, super good. My wife had the salad with grilled protein. I had a virgin Fat Elvis for desert. For breakfast, I had the biscuits and gravy. Really nice. Great service, super clean atmosphere. The blond manager was running a tight crew. The hotel is also nice.

Went here for dinner w/ my sister. We were craving crawfish and heard this is a great spot to check out. We both got a pound of crawfish , I got the cajun sauce , my sister got the garlic butter. She LOVED hers, mine lacked a little bit of flavor, no worries though what I did instead is remove all the crawfish from the shells and let them soak in the sauce bags. Easy trick and works affectively. We will be back, so many seafood options and I wouldn't mind trying them all.

Our server Michele was so awesome and helpful with the menu and his favorites. He really made me love NOLA even more with his humor and humbleness of the beginnings of NOLA. I asked to get his favorite alcoholic drink and he was all around so attentive and provided a great atmosphere for us to dine in. Food was great and a lot of photo ops here.

So disgusting the bowls are nasty and the chips taste like cereal bro don't go here go make a wrap at home come on people. Also i'm not blaming the workers i just don't like the food. Don't harass the workers because they just work there

This restaurant was definitely interesting. Apparently it's a chain, but it is the ONLY location left in Florida... and it so happened to be located in Plant City! So I thought after receiving coupons, we REALLY have to try this out! I'm so glad we did! I just want to say that it's nothing special, so don't have high hopes- it's fast food. But it's an interesting twist... Fast "ITALIAN" food... And the bread sticks kind of reminded me of OG, so that's always a huge plus there. We were able to order online do a mobile order. I got a meatball sub which was pretty good, just don't try to eat it in your car because it is the messiest thing on the face of this planet! Aside from subs, they have pastas and cheesecakes from the Cheesecake Factory, and everything seems fairly priced for fast food. It seems a bit cheaper than other "like" restaurants. I will definitely be back to try the pastas sometime soon, and may update this review when I do so!

The food is awesome and authentic. If you're looking for big portions and real deal Mexican food- this is it! 
Sophie helped us over the phone and was really sweet and patient when we asked questions. We will certainly be returning!
Food was very good and freshly made. Service was excellent. I recommend the chicken & waffles, the chicken was perfectly cooked and I'm not a fan of white meat. Prices are very reasonable.

So so good! Delicious food, lots of veggie options. The server accommodated us well for a large group, which we really appreciated. If you like spicy, you must get the cumin style tofu (they had meat option too). Dan dan noodles were delicious (duh). Will have to go there again to try their other things.

It was not good. I tried this for the first time today, and I really think that Dairy Queen should stick to what they know, which is soft serve ice cream and Blizzards. They do a terrible job with food. Quite honestly, I've had better food at truck stops. MUCH better food at truck stops. And also, this was an extremely expensive lunch for what it was. I spent almost $9 here for lunch and that was WITH a coupon. The cheeseburger I got was absolutely disgusting. I've had cheeseburgers that were frozen that tasted better. It tasted like something that was a week old that had been peeled off the floor and then reheated. It's honestly the most terrible cheeseburger I've ever had in my life. The onion rings really were pretty good, but not as good as what they were charging. Those were the best part of the actual meal though. I also got a Blizzard, which of course was delicious, because this is what Dairy Queen is known for. So I liked the Blizzard. When I got to my car, and I do mean literally the second I sat back into my car after I got my food, I got an email notification on my phone for my birthday buy one get one free Blizzard. It actually really annoyed me because I had just bought my food and spent $9 for this ridiculous meal that included a Blizzard and then I get this coupon for a buy one get one free. Which of course I couldn't use because I had already paid. I probably won't return to Dairy Queen even though I have this coupon, because the food was so bad. Like it was r
Please very Carefully at this place!! I has been in this place today and unfortunately I'm so disappointed,  and another 2 guys outside told me they found Cucarach at his food also..

The service and ambiance was wonderful,  complimentary aperitifs and petit fours were a nice touch too. But everything else left us wanting...even with a nearly $500 bill for (2) people.  We were so underwhelmed especially as this was our first visit to one of Marc Vetri's restaurants.

My wife and I were craving pizza but wanted something vegan. My wife enjoyed the vegan pile with cashew ricotta. She had it before while dining in but this was our first pickup experience. I enjoyed a bite of hers, even when not piping hot.

I tried the hive mind for the first time. It tasted great. I loved the sauce. Couldn't really tell it was vegan pepperoni as it had the same texture and was spicy.

Will definitely order again. Hard to beat wood fire pizza!
Outstanding food and wonderful people working there.  Especially in these difficult times making you feel like family!  Support this business!!!

This place is very popular and does not take reservations.  You can call in when you are on your way and get your name on the wait list. This review is for the restaurant on Orchard, not on the river.  I just really enjoy the comfortable relaxed atmosphere, friendly servers and delicious food.  Pricing is reasonable.  This is my favorite Italian in Boise!

Ordered over $50 worth of take out on a third party delivery app, a good 45-minutes before their posted closing time.  About 15-minutes later I was notified that they had closed.  By the time I was notified other places I would have chosen we closed (at their posted closing times).  Hard to make money during a pandemic when you don't stick to your advertised hours of operation.  Won't try it again.
Stopped in before seeing 1917 across the walkway at the IMAX theater! Nice staff. Burgers were decent, nice way to waste a few minutes before seeing a movie!

I've been here before for a catered party and the food was wonderful. I more recently took my boyfriend for our anniversary dinner since he's never been before. The service was well paced and the staff was friendly; we got our appetizer quickly and the main course came shortly after we finished.  My boyfriend loved his Seafood Alfredo so much he literally licked the plate clean! And dessert was equally as wonderful. This place is an excellent place for a date night out. I Will be coming back to try the Brunch menu with my boo :)

Stopped here for a quick girl's lunch with my co-workers. Mint Lemonade was tasty. Ordered shrimp tacos, which was served with a side salad with a vinaigrette dressing. Not impressed. Meal was nothing to write home about, but the outdoor seating was super cute.
Awesome beniets. Great price too. They were fresh, hot and delicious. Will be on my to return to list anytime I'm in New Orleans.

This place is phenomenal. I moved from Philadelphia to South Jersey and had yet to find a really great Vietnamese restaurant. After trying this place I can safely say my search is over! I always get the pho which is fantastic. My wife usually gets vermicelli noodles and they are absolutely delicious. We've also tried the stir fry - yum! The service is very fast and the family who runs it is super friendly and always makes us feel welcome. This is our go-to place for Vietnamese, you should try it!

Excellent food always top it off with a great host Luigi.
You feel like your eating back in time at mama's house.

I went recently and the food is still really good. The changes you've made have improved the work flow and I'm sure improved your profit margins. Very positive changes. Needs a bit more tweaking but you are getting there.
Phenomenal. Inhaled the pie vice liquid courage, says a lot about the quality.

AMAZING!!! From the moment I stepped foot in the door, the experience was amazing. The staff was on point and friendly and attentive. It was a triple date night and it was fabulous. The tables were socially distanced from all angles. Staff wore masks. The food was fantastic. We went from coolinary but also got non-coolinary items. The lobster dumplings were so delicious, the sauce was muah!!! The crab cakes were tasty too...all crab little filler. The tuna tacos were so fresh. The sorbets for dessert were super tasty and the perfect end to a perfect meal. I'll be back. Can't wait to be back!!!

This is your standard, middle TN, bland, Americanized Mexican restaurant. But it's a cheap, filling lunch. For $6 I got a taco & enchilada plate with rice and beans, plus the nacho bowl with canned salsa.  The taco is the American version, a 5 or 6 inch, prefab corn tortilla shell, as in Taco Bell, with lettuce & tomato, cheese. I was able to choose chicken instead of ground beef, though. No discernible spice on the chicken. The beef enchilada was OK. Rice and beans: not a lot of flavor. But this is a good, safe place to take native Tennesseans without fear anyone will object to the spice level.

My partner and I always drive by this place and we're drawn to the curb appeal and design. So cute! The perfect city neighborhood bar. We had just finished eating so we only ordered drinks. They were really tasty. The community fridge is the cutest thing, we love the concept! The menu was solid mostly made up of bar food (wings, fries, burgers, grilled cheese, etc). We will def come back for food.

So glad I ordered take out from here! Super yummy and my order was still fresh and hot when I got back home with it. The inside was clean and the staff was friendly. They are taking COVID precautions. Definitely will be back!!
Friendly staff but ridiculous prices. And we waited a  half hour for 2 orders of potatoes. Not coming back

Tried First watch for the First time while visiting family in the area from Chicago. I can't say enough wonderful things about this establishment!!! I was so impressed right out of the gate with how gorgeous the place was and friendly the staff was. We were seated quickly and they were able to easily accommodate our wheelchair as well. The coffee was by far the best I'd ever had at a family restaurant and the food was unreal. I ordered the avocado toast and it was the freshest, creamiest avocado, i also ordered a side of the homemade chicken sausage and it didn't disappoint. The kids were kept busy with crayons and the waitress was super sweet. We can't wait to return during our next visit South. Thank you so much for the excellent meal!

Found this place while on the Gulp Coast tour. Great little local place with fresh cooked foods and our waiter/ bar maid Dee was very friendly and took care of the whole place on her own.  I had the grouper wrap and coleslaw and it was delicious.  The place is in a strip mall and had it not been for the tour we would not have come across it. They had two of heir own beers on tap and I had the IPA which was as good as any of the other larger breweries around.   Definitely check this place out.

Awful management at this location. Get a take out order and the woman behind the counter is belligerent to you. 

The food is only so-so. Really not worth my time or my stress to deal with them.

We went there after work.And my husband food didn't look very good.He had ordered the meatlovers omelet the cheese wasn't melted all the way and his potatoes were over cooked.Well will not be going back anytime soon

This restaurant was seriously amazing. We came for brunch and the owner was our server. He had so much knowledge when it came to the wine selection and the food was AMAZING. There is absolutely not a bad thing I can say about this restaurant. *Chefs kiss*

I had stopped in with a friend to take a break while roaming about. We were greeted right away and notified about what was going on and how we had to order during the current times. 

They have a good variety of beers that would satisfy all palates and for those non-alcoholic drinkers they have several options as well. Currently during the Covid times, food is required and they have some various things such as tacos, a burger, torta, burrito, quesadilla, and Lebanese sfeehas. 

Although we couldn't sit inside due to the times it looked nice. Nicely lighted, brick lined walls, various seating, and with a high ceiling. 

I did a sampler with four beers for a great price. All were great! The lager and the ale were my favorites of the four. 

Night Lizard Lager - Crisp, light, refreshing So-Cal style helles lager

Live Forever IPA - A dry San Diego style IPA featuring Simcoe, Mosaic, and Critra Hops

Island Fox Red Ale - A malty sytle red ale with sweet caramel, nut & toasted bread

Song Sparrow Sour - A Berliner Weisse style sour.
Their food is always so good! Never disappoints. My go-to dishes are pad thai and pad see ew.

Had lunch here on Friday very nice atmosphere right on the cotee river very nice view. Had the oysters there a little on the pricey side but good nice selection of food and drinks. I would recommend this place.

Had a mishap with our last order so a manager offered a free pizza. So it is 2 weeks later. We go inside and speak to the young man manning the front end. His name is Zayden. He is charming, Delightful, Professional and Immediately jumped into action. He took care of Everything.... We are now home enjoying.  Tasty pizza and wings.

We heard about the place from friends who wouldn't shut up about the beef eggplant dish. So after the Saints game we didn't feel like cooking  and decided to walk down to see if it was as good as they said.  It was excellent and worth the wait. Pro tip: sign in on yelp before showing up and you won't have to wait so long or wait at a nearby dive bar like we did, which was lovely in its own way.

I stopped in just for a drink, and my expectations were exceeded (I'm not the easiest mixed drink critic)! I had an OV Margarita (the classic rocks margarita) to start off and it was tastey and strong. For my second drink, I ordered the El Jardin and...it's basically a margarita with a splash of freshness from cucumber plus a hint of spice and a splash of awesomeness. It will definitely be my go-to at Orta Vez. Can't wait to go back and try the tacos! Also, the bar tender was super friendly!
My wife and I stop by this past Sunday, for some drinks and food. I always forget how good Green Iguanas happy hour is. We are definitely coming back ASAP!
We loved the incredible oysters Bienville and the Boudin balls. Great service and incredible food. We returned twice during a short weekend!

Nom nom. 
Always food food and good drinks! Friendly staff make this place even more enjoyable!! Park your car wherever you can find a spot and walk.

Okay Yelped you checked in  you reviews and you sold me on eating here and the food did the rest.  Great chili cheese hot dog , great Daly's double burger, great fries.  My new all favorite burger place and I will be back soon and add a shake next time.  I wouldn't have found this lil gem without Yelp as I missed it for years until I saw a check I today and read the reviews.

Way too pricey for what you get and the food wasn't even good. Look at this pizza  the butter knife is there for scale. This is a $20 gluten free white pizza that was burnt and didn't even fill the box. Apple bread desert was just half one of these pizza with apple and Carmel drizzled cut into French toast sticks. Will deff not order again and will inform friends not to waste their money

All the food was delicious and fresh
Plenty of space to sit
Could use a little more decor/updating and deep cleaning but overall I would recommend and will be back .
